learning_outcomes.text: Achieving B1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference.
Consolidating and broadening linguistic knowledge acquired in high school.
Developing oral and written communication skills.
Developing skills for understanding a written or oral message.
Familiarization with the cultural and civilization values of other peoples who speak German.

syllabus_topics: Developing the ability to communicate in German in specific situations (e.g., discussing an engineer's job responsibilities, describing production process stages, teamwork).
Developing the ability to communicate in German in profession-specific situations (e.g., product presentation: dimensions, shapes, characteristics, materials, units of measurement).
Developing project creation skills, information gathering techniques (e.g., topic setting, research, documentation).
Review and consolidation exercises for studied topics; student examination.
teaching_methods: Interactive methods based on conversational techniques and progressive knowledge acquisition: conversation, explanation, example, conversation simulation, brainstorming, project development, audio recordings.
assessment_rules: The final grade consists of the activity grade (50%) and the knowledge verification test grade (50%). The minimum performance standard requires acquiring at least 50% of the grammar and vocabulary knowledge taught in the seminar, verified through exercises similar to those performed in the seminar.
